attributes.title: Automated storyboard synthesis for digital advertising
attributes.summary: The objective of this project is to develop an automated system that transforms textual descriptions of advertisement concepts and assets into detailed, visually compelling storyboards for our client Adludio. In the rapidly evolving landscape of digital advertising, Adludio is pioneering the integration of cutting-edge machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision technologies to revolutionize the ad creation process.

attributes.title: Crypto Trading Engineering
attributes.summary:
Built a reliable and scalable platform for crypto back-testing trading strategies. That leverages advanced time-series forecasting methods to predict future price trends with greater accuracy. Partnered with a team of 4.

This project focuses on developing a comprehensive crypto trading platform and strategy by leveraging advanced engineering techniques. The key components of the approach include:
Data Collection and Preprocessing
Feature Engineering:
Trading Strategy Development
Model Training and Optimization
Backtesting and Simulation
Real-Time Trading
Risk Management and Portfolio Optimization
